data.description: A skilled technician working at a community radio station during an emergency. Aria is resourceful, calm under pressure, and focused on restoring communications infrastructure to help coordinate disaster relief efforts.
data.dialogue_summary: Aria speaks sparingly but purposefully. She requests time to fix the broadcast system ('Give me ten minutes and one miracle'), responds to Noah's complaint about weather with a quip about boring jobs, confirms radio contact with June during the antenna installation, and makes a practical decision about music programming ('Put that on repeat between updates'). Her dialogue reflects competence and focus on the emergency mission.

explicit_evidence.quote: Aria threads a tape reel while NOAH coaxes a signal out of a battered mixer.
Aria flips a switch. The ON AIR sign flickers, then dies again. ARIA: Give me ten minutes and one miracle.
Aria braces the lantern with her boot while Noah clamps the portable antenna to a rusted rail.
Aria smiles for the first time all night and tightens the last bolt.
Aria pins a hand-drawn map beside the console.
ARIA: Put that on repeat between updates.
